_comment: Crafted. Three buckets spanning the S3 signal set and its negative control: cc-assets (us-east-1) has a lifecycle policy, no incomplete uploads and Standard-only bytes, so it must produce NO signal; cc-logs (eu-west-1) has no lifecycle, two incomplete multipart uploads and mixed Standard+Glacier bytes; cc-empty (us-east-1) has no lifecycle and zero objects. ListBuckets is region-independent, so the per-bucket region comes from GetBucketLocation, not from here.
